mission.title: How and Why
mission.description: Look for Danielle Wright among the Exiles, then witness her talk with Agent Gray.

npc.say:
No, no! Not me! I didn't even know that guy!
Wright who? Ohh, the crazy glowing woman? Uh... No... But-- But why don't you just be my guest and check the computer over there? There was some kind of spam about a problem, but I ignored it... I'm off-duty. Uh, the password is "Mistletoe."
These were just to get their attention. Their responses aren't very difficult to predict.

phase.briefing:
Operative, we know that Danielle Wright has access to override codes, but she does not appear to be using the broadcast type utilized by the Oligarchs, from whom she must have obtained those codes; a scan of her signal was unable to identify any type of data transmission at all. Without a means of finding her broadcast source in the Real, we have no effective way of stopping her activities.
It has been decided that we will make an attempt to get Wright to talk; this may result in no useful information, but we have found that humans are often unable to resist discussing their achievements.
We know that Wright has been searching for the biological interface program in the Merovingian's chateau. This search appears to have moved into the city. You will investigate Exile activity there for signs of Wright.

enter.say: Okay, these Exiles were spotted coming through backdoors suspected of having connections to the chateau. They may know something about this Wright stuff.

talk.say:
No, no! Not me! I didn't even know that guy!
Wright who? Ohh, the crazy glowing woman? Uh... No... But-- But why don't you just be my guest and check the computer over there? There was some kind of spam about a problem, but I ignored it... I'm off-duty. Uh, the password is "Mistletoe."

done.say: Got it. Let's go check it out.
Continue, {player}. If it is Wright, she cares little for the Exiles themselves, and will not remain long with them.

near.say: Hey, Francis, have you seen my copy of--
Hey, leave one of them alive! We need someone to talk to!
I told you not to have subscriptions mailed here!
Oh boy, my display is spazzing out. I think we've got an override overload in there.

phase.briefing: Operative, heavy override use has just been detected at another area not far from your position. Programs in the area have failed. This requires immediate investigation.

enter.say: Even more override activity than where you just were with Wright. This can't be good...

talk.say: I've had a thought. There is something I want to discuss with them. Have them open a channel.
Uh... Okay, I'm getting in touch with Gray about this.

done.say: I will be conversing with Wright. She has asked that you be present, as what she termed a..."witness."

Call me crazy, but I don't like the sound of this "witness" thing.
They've cleared out our other programs, so it'll just be the three of you.

talk.say: Very well. For our part, we would like to know how you have apparently survived the termination of your body. The technology you borrowed would not suffice in itself.

How I "exceeded my parameters," hm?
Yes...I could tell you that. But not here... And I want your operatives to hear it.
There's something I'll need you to tell me, too: why did the Oracle make the interface program?

done.say: Information on the interface program is restricted... However, I believe that in this case an exception will have to be made.
They'll take some time to get around to approving it.

mission.finish: Thank you, {player}. As Wright has requested a larger operative presence, if the exchange of information is approved, your attendance may be asked for.
